Sample.evidence_source: A total of 12 men participated in the study.

Country.evidence_source: The study was conducted in the Republic of Ireland.

Population.evidence_source: Inclusion criteria were: male, aged 18 years or over, had made at least one suicide attempt, and were able to give informed consent.

Type.evidence_source: This study was part of a larger research project that explored the experiences of men who had attempted suicide.

Area.evidence_source: The interviews explored participants' experiences leading up to, during, and following a suicide attempt, as well as their perceptions of recovery and support.
